name: Variety Show
description: Parents can volunteer as stage hands or concession organizers. Students can sign up to perform. Audition videos are due by 3/1, dress rehearsal is 3/19, and the show is on 3/20.

name: PTA Math Kangaroo
description: Event for students to participate in the Math Kangaroo competition.

name: Multicultrual Fair!
description: This year's Multicultural Fair will take place on Friday April 24th from 4-7pm. A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance. Due to time constraints, solo and duo performances are encouraged to perform at the Los Alamitos Variety Show on March 20th (sign up by March 1st).

name: PTA Variety Show Audition Videos Due
description: Students must submit audition videos by this date to be considered for the Variety Show.

name: Yearbook Cover Contest (5th Graders Only)
description: Entries due by February 23, 2026. Los Alamitos PTA is inviting all Los Alamitos 5th graders to enter their drawings in our Yearbook cover contest. 2 winners will be selected to be displayed on the front and back cover, by the Yearbook committee panel.

name: NOWRUZ (IRANIAN NEW YEAR) STAFF LUNCHEON
description: Please join us as we treat our staff to a delicious luncheon on Thursday, March 19th, to celebrate the upcoming Iranian New Year and the first day of spring!

name: Variety Show – Volunteers & Important Info
description: We're gearing up for our upcoming Variety Show on Friday, March 20th and need parent volunteers to help make it a success! Volunteer opportunities include Stage Hands - to assist performers, Concession Organizer - to coordinate snacks and sales. We are also looking for a volunteer who can provide a digital keyboard for the event. To Apply to the Variety Show: Do you have a talent to share? Sing, Rap, Dance, Lip Sync, Magic, Musical Instrument, Cheer Performance, Skit, Monologue, Jump Rope, Yo Yo, Puppet show, Comedy Routine, Impressions, Mime, Martial Arts demo, Poetry, Baton twirling.

name: Incoming 2025/26 Castillero 6th grade parents!
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed!
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) from 12:45pm - 2:00pm during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding!

name: Yearbook Update
description: We are looking for photos from PTA events this year! If you have photos from the following events and would like them to be shared in the yearbook, please upload to these Google Drive Folders! Spirit Days, Dandy Day, Bubblefest, Science-o-rama, Dances. 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages! They are due by March 31st! Last day to order yearbook: 4/20.

name: Sponsor Spotlight
description: We are so grateful to our generous sponsors whose support helps make our PTA programs and events possible. Your contributions strengthen our school community and create lasting experiences for our students. Thank you for investing in our kids and in Los Alamitos!
